preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of drawings k must be exactly 2.

postconditions.description: The output must start with either 'YES' or 'NO'.
If the output starts with 'YES', it must contain exactly n + 1 lines.
If the output starts with 'NO', it must contain exactly 1 line.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output starts with 'YES', each of the next n lines must contain exactly two integers.
